name: Game Jam (48 hours)
description: A tight plan for a 48-hour jam: idea in the first hour, playable core after 12 hours, content and polish after that, upload with time to spare.
author: Gamedev Dashboard

goals.title: Hour 0-2: Idea
steps: Write the core loop in one sentence

goals.title: Hour 12-36: Content
steps: 3 short levels or one growing level
Art for the player and enemies

goals.title: Hour 46-48: Ship
steps: Build for the web or Windows
Write the page text and add screenshots

pages.title: Jam notes
pages.markdown:
# Theme
Example: "Only one"

## Idea
A platformer where you can place only one block at a time; placing a new one removes the old one.

## Cut list
Things that sound fun but will not make it in time:
- Level editor
- Online leaderboard
- Second character

> Rule: if it is not fun after 12 hours, simplify. Do not add features.
